summary: ATA Creativity Global filed a 6-K attaching notice of an extraordinary general meeting to approve two transformative transactions: the sale of subsidiaries (ATA BVI and a 69% stake in Huanqiuyimeng) to Robox Holding for nominal cash consideration of RMB1, and a concurrent PIPE issuing 45.3M common shares at an aggregate price of US$21.1M (implying ~US$0.47/share). Effectively, the filings describe a de facto spin-off/disposition of core operating assets followed by a capital injection into the reduced entity. Shareholder meeting scheduled for June 5, 2026; proxies due by June 2, 2026. The structural separation and subsequent PIPE resemble a spin-off/restructuring. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance in China.
